findings.title: Signal has major reference plane gap
findings.description: Net unconnected-(U3-GPIO9-Pad9) has 0% reference plane coverage over 3.2mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
findings.summary: Signal has major reference plane gap

findings.title: Decoupling cap C3 far from via
findings.description: C3 is 3.7mm from the nearest via (~2.6nH connection inductance). Long traces between cap and via degrade high-frequency decoupling effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Place a via directly adjacent to C3 pads. Use fat, short traces from cap pads to via.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J3
findings.description: Connector J3 (UART_DEBUG_PROGRAM) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J3. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, B.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers F.Cu and B.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (58×50mm, εr=4.5) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1215 MHz; (0,1) at 1413 MHz; (1,1) at 1863 MHz; (2,0) at 2430 MHz; (2,1) at 2811 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /BAT_ADC
findings.description: Net /BAT_ADC has 1 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 1 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 3.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 3.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /BAT_ADC
